summary: Market tone looks cautiously bullish for major crypto, with BTC still the cleanest consensus long and several altcoins showing selective upside setups. The strongest fresh themes today are ETH rotation, RENDER/AVAX/LINK support-buy interest, and renewed BTC strength, while the limited available macro feed is pointing to a risk-on bias rather than broad panic.
